title: A custom role made from Office User never grays out Technician
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a custom role made for this test from the Office User template, role A (Settings, Roles & Permissions, Create custom role).
  • Start on Settings, Staff.
custom_steps:
1. Open the New Staff Member window.
  2. If Time Clock is off, switch it on.
  3. In Role, pick role A.
  4. Switch Technician on.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The New Staff Member window opens.

Step 2:

  • Time Clock is on.

Step 3:

  • Role shows role A.
  • Technician is off and not grayed out.

Step 4:

  • Technician is on.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Technician Toggle", Confluence 977371146, version 17 (2 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 2 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11788, story SV-11879 (Story 1, Technician toggle on a staff member)

  • S1-N1: “When the role picked in the window is the built-in Office User or Time Clock User role, the Technician toggle is off and grayed out, and hovering it shows "This role can't be a technician." Picking one of those roles turns Technician off. In Edit Staff Member, saving a staff member who was saved with Technician on and now has one of those roles shows the Turn Off Technician warning first (Story 2). Any other role, including a custom role made from either built-in role, never grays it out.”
  • S1-R3: “In the New Staff Member window, Technician is pre-filled from the role shown: on when the role is the built-in Technician or the built-in Foreman role and Time Clock is on, otherwise off. Every other role pre-fills off, including Parts Technician and every custom role, even one made from Technician or Foreman. The pre-fill runs when the window opens and again each time the role or Time Clock is changed, until the user switches Technician by hand. From then on the user's choice wins: changing the role or Time Clock no longer pre-fills it, though S1-R4 and S1-N1 still turn it off, and only the user turns it back on. The toggle as shown is what is saved. Edit Staff Member never pre-fills (S1-E1).”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

The design's own words:

  • “On the built-in Office User or Time Clock User role, Technician is off and grayed out. Tooltip, verbatim: "This role can't be a technician." Picking one of those roles turns Technician off.”
  • “Any other role, including a custom role copied from either one, never grays it out.”

The design draws the Office User role only; Time Clock User and the custom roles are not drawn (register TT-N03).
